_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ir shpilt Klondike Solitaire. Ayer tsihl iz tsu movn ale karten tsu di fundament-pilen.

Shpil-reglen:
- Fundament-pilen (F1-F4): Boyt oyf fun Ace tsu Kenig in farb
- Tabelepilen (T1-T7): Boyt arop in alternirnde farbn (royt af shvarts, shvarts af royt)
- Zapas: Tsien karten tsu waste-pilen
- Waste (W): Di ovste karte iz tsugenglekh far shpil

Komanden:
- 'draw' - Tsien karten fun zapas tsu waste
- 'move <kvayl> <tsil> [count]' - Mov karten tsvishe pilen
  Beyspilen: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count ken oykh zayn 'all', vos vet pruvn tsu movn ale aufgedekte karten.
- 'forfeit' - Endikt das shpil azoy vey iz un shperrt in ayer itstike score
- Pilen-namen: W (waste), F1-F4 (fundamentn), T1-T7 (tabelepilen)

Ir kent ausfirn meerdere aksies in eyn runde durkh komata tsuteyln:
  Beyspil: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Nor Kenign kenen gelegt vern oyf leydike tabelepilen.
Aksies firn oyf in rekhtn folger - oyb eyn faylt, di iberige aksies vern ibergegangen.
Nutst 'forfeit' oyb ir glaybt das shpil iz unmeglekh tsu gevinnen.
